mentions.name: Porchweather
mentions.description: A free app that notifies users when weather conditions are right for opening windows instead of running air conditioning, helping save money and enjoy fresh air. Users set their own thresholds for temperature, humidity, wind speed, and precipitation chance, and receive alerts via email or web push; SMS was skipped as too expensive for a free service.
mentions.problem: People run air conditioning without knowing when outdoor conditions would be suitable for opening windows, costing money and missing fresh air.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://porchweather.com/ - free app for notifying you when the weather is right for opening your windows. The idea is to save you a few bucks on using air conditioning as well as simply enjoying some fresh air.

Tracks temp, humidity, wind speed, and precip chance and you set the parameters.
